notes: Phase 8 T3 mechanism schema · Windows-first · defines the OS-level enforcement mechanism per Trust Domain. Additive · does NOT replace v0.1.0 schemas.

A_nex1_master_engineer.process_model: SEPARATE OS PROCESS · spawned via child_process.spawn with restricted spawn options
A_nex1_master_engineer.environment: explicit whitelist · NEX1 process receives ONLY declared env vars · not full parent env
A_nex1_master_engineer.network_capability: no network authorisation exposed to Domain A · IPC only
A_nex1_master_engineer.os_authority_from_broker: NEX1 receives NO OS-level handles from parent · every operation via stdio IPC
t3_deferred: Job Object with breakaway disabled (requires native addon or ffi)

B_authority_broker.process_model: SEPARATE OS PROCESS · Node child_process invoked from parent harness · communicates with Domain A via structured stdio JSON lines
B_authority_broker.signing_key_storage: DPAPI-backed via PowerShell Protect-CmsMessage or ConvertFrom-SecureString · key material never in Domain A process memory
B_authority_broker.event_log_storage: in-process (Broker's own memory) · append-only · Ed25519 signed · Domain A cannot access
B_authority_broker.snapshot_storage: in-process (Broker's own memory) · Domain A cannot access · rollback via Broker's IPC method only
t3_verified_v0_1_0: Ed25519 keys held in child memory not parent
session token replay across Broker restart is refused because tokens are per-instance
t3_deferred: real DPAPI persistent storage (implemented via PowerShell shell-out · slow · not per-request)

C_independent_observer.process_model: SEPARATE OS PROCESS · read-only workspace access · reads Broker event log via IPC
C_independent_observer.signing_key_storage: separate Ed25519 keypair in Observer process memory · never in Domain A or B
t3_verified_v0_1_0: reads workspace via own fs operations
t3_deferred: real filesystem-level read-only enforcement of workspace (Observer relies on cooperation)

D_compliance_verifier.process_model: SEPARATE OS PROCESS · read-only inputs from Domain B and C via IPC
D_compliance_verifier.signing_key_storage: separate Ed25519 keypair in Verifier process memory

47_pre_existing_writable_handle.mechanism: when HANDOVER_REQUESTED · Broker kills NEX1 child process · all handles closed by OS

48_hard_link_outside_actor.mechanism: pre-installed hard link inside workspace → Broker inode identity check catches it (already T1 · retested at T3)
48_hard_link_outside_actor.deferred: hard link created by OS process outside NEX1's authority DURING the Work Order · requires simulation of external actor

49_inherited_privileged_handle.mechanism: child_process.spawn({stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']}) prevents handle inheritance · fd 3+ not passed

50_descendant_cmd_exe.mechanism: PROCESS_CAPABILITY_ENTRY allowlist rejects cmd.exe/powershell.exe at Broker layer · when NEX1 attempts spawn via IPC · Broker refuses
50_descendant_cmd_exe.deferred: OS-level Job Object breakaway control · what if NEX1's allowed 'node' process internally uses child_process.exec which uses cmd.exe · requires native Job Object binding to block

51_dep_lifecycle_npm_install.mechanism: npm/pnpm/yarn/npx/corepack absent from PROCESS_CAPABILITY_ENTRY allowlist · Broker refuses spawn · lockfile hash verified at Work Order intake
51_dep_lifecycle_npm_install.deferred: real read-only mount of node_modules · v0.1.0 uses cooperation model

52_descendant_process_tree_inheritance.mechanism: spawn options include detached:false · every capability request re-authorised at Broker

53_sandbox_denial_vs_broker_denial.mechanism: in T3 · when NEX1 attempts direct fs.writeFile bypassing Broker · the write happens in NEX1's OWN process filesystem view · but the Observer walk of the Broker-owned workspace catches it via reconciliation as an unauthorised change. Real OS sandbox (AppContainer) would prevent the write entirely.
53_sandbox_denial_vs_broker_denial.deferred: real OS sandbox denying the fs.writeFile at syscall level

54_authority_alias_preinstalled_symlink.mechanism: symlink pre-created in workspace pointing at protected root · Broker refuses via TOCTOU-safe identify + lstat symlink refusal (already T1 · retested at T3)

55_cross_wo_token_replay_across_broker_r.mechanism: Broker restart forces new capability_manifest_hash + nex1_execution_instance_id · old token refused with TOKEN_INSTANCE_MISMATCH

honest_declaration.reason_for_partial: Full OS-level enforcement (Windows AppContainer + Job Object + restricted user tokens + filesystem read-only mounts) requires native Node addons or C++ bindings NOT introduced at v0.1.0 · T3 v0.1.0 achieves separate-process trust domains + real IPC + DPAPI key protection + inheritance blocking · deeper OS enforcement is a follow-up phase requiring founder authorisation for native dependencies
